ns2:course.label: Advanced Wetland Theory and Techniques
ns2:course.description: Students will investigate the science behind the conservation, restoration, and monitoring of wetlands. The first part of the course will focus on the theory and techniques used during wetland delineation of hydrology, hydric soils, and vegetation. The second part of the course will focus on wetland management with a focus on best practices regarding the conservation, restoration and monitoring of wetlands. Prerequisite: NRES 417. Restricted to Wetland Science and Conservation Graduate Certificate.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: NRES 417. Restricted to Wetland Science and Conservation Graduate Certificate.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BS:Met Food & Enviro Sys -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Nat Res & EnvSci ONL-UIUC, MS:Ag Ldrship Ed&Com ONL- UIUC, BSLAS: ESES Online - UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or GCRT:Wetland Sci&Cns ONL-UIUC.
